description: We’re two friends from Turkmenistan, now studying CS in the U.S.: Dovlet (Kent State) and Rahman (ASU). Rahman built an AI  surplus resale business, that scans auctions, values lots using real sold prices and recommends buy, watch or skip. He also researches diffusion models at ASU. Dovlet, a CS student with a Data Science minor, built the backend and data filtering for an ML platform matching sponsors with pro sports teams at KSU. We cover software, AI/ML, data analysis and data management.
